author: Zephyr I
title: Depth ablation: stack bottleneck residuals per stage (1 vs 2), d=5 (single-step LN-ConvLSTM)
abstract: Test scaling via depth: compare 1 vs 2 bottleneck-dilated residual blocks per CNN stage on the non-FE d=5 single-step LN-ConvLSTM baseline under default PG. Fixed compute-friendly settings; BASE_SEED=42.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/zephyr')
from networks.cnn_convlstm_layernorm_single_step_dilated_bottleneck_depth import DilatedBottleneckDepthNet
from ray import tune

BASE_SEED = 42

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': tune.choice([4e-4]),
        'entropy_coef': tune.choice([0.01]),
        'value_loss_coef': tune.choice([0.5]),
        'cnn_features_1': tune.choice([32]),
        'cnn_features_2': tune.choice([64]),
        'conv_lstm_features': tune.choice([64]),
        'bottleneck_ratio': tune.choice([0.5]),
        'use_silu': tune.choice([False]),
        'num_blocks': tune.choice([1, 2]),
    }

def create_network(hparams):
    nb = int(hparams['num_blocks'])
    return DilatedBottleneckDepthNet(
        cnn_features_1=32,
        cnn_features_2=64,
        conv_lstm_features=64,
        dilation=5,
        bottleneck_ratio=0.5,
        use_silu=False,
        num_blocks1=nb,
        num_blocks2=nb,
    )
